title: Lear and Jim Goodall camp out at Area 51 in the '70s

tellings.quote: John Lear and his good friend and aviation photographer and journalist named Jim Goodall are camping out of Area 51 and Groom Lake constantly.

plain: In the 1970s a man named John Lear and his good friend Jim Goodall, an aviation photographer and journalist, were constantly camping out near Area 51 and Groom Lake, a secret US test site in Nevada. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in a documentary about early secret work on UFO-like craft.
